name: Acrylfentanyl
metabolism: Broken down much the way fentanyl and acetylfentanyl are. In all, 14 breakdown products were found -- in human urine after hydrolysis, in liver-cell incubations, and in a few people who died after taking it.
summary: Acrylfentanyl is a potent opioid analgesic and fentanyl analogue that has been sold online as a designer drug.
